bottlenecks.observation: Each method commonly required 12-20 seconds, while complex methods reached about 24-28 seconds. Full 12/16/26-method sweeps dominated wall time.
The hard agent repeatedly fixed one local diagnostic and reran the broad gate, sometimes using buffered tail/head pipelines that delayed feedback.
